theorems.name: Submission.cmc_fc_series_limit
theorems.statement: (∀ (P d : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (Ts : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U d) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U d), IsOpen U → (∀ j, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ts j)) → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → ⨆ j, ((Ts j).massOn W + boundaryMassOn (Ts j) W) < ∞) → WeaklyConvergesOn Ts T → IsIntegerMultiplicity T) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (A B : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity A → IsIntegerMultiplicity B → IsIntegerMultiplicity (A - B)) → ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (Xlim : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (Λ : NNReal) (R : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 2)) (S : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsOpen U → WeaklyConvergesOn X Xlim → (∀ r, (X r).mass ≤ Λ ∧ (X r).boundary.mass ≤ Λ) → (∀ r, IsIntegerMultiplicity (R r) ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity (S r) ∧ X (r + 1) - X r - S r = (R r).boundary ∧ (R r).mass + (S r).mass ≤ (2⁻¹ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ r) → ∀ ℓ : ℕ, ∃ (R' : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 2)) (S' : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity R' ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity S' ∧ Xlim - X ℓ - S' = R'.boundary ∧ R'.mass + S'.mass ≤ 2 * (2⁻¹ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ ℓ
